sourceLanes.label: LinkedIn Jobs
sourceLanes.resumeFrom: Retry Analytics Intern in Noida at start 50 for past 24 hours, Fraud Analyst in Bengaluru at start 25 for past 24 hours, and Analytics Intern in Gurugram at start 25 for past 7 days; then repeat the full matrix and continue high-yield pagination
sourceLanes.notes: The three saved checkpoints were recovered first. A controlled 17-role-family by four-location past-24-hour matrix at starts 0, 25, and 50, an eight-family past-7-day matrix at starts 0 and 25, and the saved retries completed 268 of 271 requests. Eleven genuinely new direct listings passed freshness, location, live-route, experience, and deduplication gates: Care.fi Data Analyst; Mastercard Associate Analyst Analytics & Metrics; Wissen MIS Executive or Analyst; myfollo Market Research Intern; NEMA AI Business & Market Analyst Intern; Level AI AI Analyst; Clearwater Reconciliation Associate; Intralox Junior BI Developer or Data Engineer; Lowe's Supply Chain Analyst; eazyway Data Analyst; and Metasys Data & Analytics Analyst. The full pre-update audit found Nutrabay Analytics Engineer and Cuemath Associate Operations & Analytics closed, and both were archived. Scoutit and TechWise Digital looked live in search rendering but failed immediate direct-page verification and were excluded before publication. Fresh index refreshes with stale direct dates, senior requirements, contradictions, or duplicate company-role-location identities were also excluded.

The previously surfaced unidentified Business Analyst Intern post still cannot be displayed and remains excluded. No post-only opportunity passed the original-post and usable-route gates.
